CAN.note: World's #1 pulse exporter (lentils, dry peas; Saskatchewan). FAOSTAT/AAFC: ~8.4 Mt production 2024; ~6.3 Mt exports (HS 0713).

AUS.note: Major chickpea/lentil exporter; chickpea crop surged in 2024 on India demand. ABARES/FAOSTAT: ~4.2 Mt production, ~3.5 Mt exports. Heavily India-exposed.

MMR.note: Leading dry-bean (black gram/pigeon pea) exporter, almost entirely to India. FAOSTAT: ~6.3 Mt production; ~1.5 Mt exports.

RUS.note: Fast-growing pea/lentil exporter; signed India market-access deal 2023-24. FAOSTAT/Rosstat: ~5.5 Mt production, ~2.7 Mt exports.

USA.note: Significant pea/lentil/dry-bean producer-exporter (ND, MT). USDA/FAOSTAT: ~3.1 Mt production; ~1.3 Mt exports vs ~0.35 Mt imports.

ARG.note: Leading South American dry-bean/chickpea exporter. FAOSTAT/INDEC: ~1.1 Mt production, ~0.75 Mt exports.

ETH.note: Large faba-bean/chickpea/lentil producer; exports beans and chickpeas. FAOSTAT: ~4.3 Mt production; ~0.6 Mt exports.

TZA.note: Major pulse (pigeon pea, chickpea, bean) exporter to India and regional markets. FAOSTAT: ~2.4 Mt production, ~0.7 Mt exports.

MEX.note: Large dry-bean producer/consumer; small net importer of beans from USA despite exporting chickpeas. FAOSTAT/SIAP: ~1.3 Mt production.

UKR.note: Pea exporter (India, Turkey, EU) despite war disruption. FAOSTAT: ~0.9 Mt production, ~0.55 Mt exports.

IND.note: World's largest pulse producer AND largest importer/consumer. FAOSTAT/DGCIS: ~27 Mt production but ~33 Mt consumption. 2024 imports ~6.8 Mt (Comtrade HS 0713) as govt removed duties to cool prices.

BGD.note: Lentil/pea deficit; large importer of lentils (Canada, Russia, Australia) and dry peas. FAOSTAT/Comtrade: ~0.95 Mt production vs ~0.75 Mt imports.

PAK.note: Chickpea/lentil deficit; major importer of dry peas, chickpeas, beans. Comtrade 2024: imports ~1.21 Mt (HS 0713) led by Russia, Australia, Afghanistan.

TUR.note: Lentil/chickpea producer but also a processing/re-export hub: imports ~1.35 Mt (Comtrade 2024, led by Russia, Canada, Kazakhstan) and re-exports ~0.9 Mt.

CHN.note: Large producer (broad beans, mung beans) but major importer of dry peas (feed/starch, from Canada/Russia). FAOSTAT/Comtrade: imports ~1.5 Mt.

EGY.note: Faba-bean staple but huge deficit; major importer of faba beans, lentils, beans (Australia, Russia, UK, Canada). FAOSTAT/GASC: imports ~1.1 Mt.

DZA.note: Chickpea/lentil/dry-bean deficit; imports mainly from Canada, Argentina, USA, Turkey. FAOSTAT/Comtrade: imports ~0.78 Mt.

rankings.note: Importers India/Turkiye/Pakistan are UN Comtrade 2024 reported (HS 0713); China/Egypt/Algeria/Bangladesh/USA/Mexico totals and all exporter totals are FAOSTAT/USDA 2024 structural estimates. Canada is #1 exporter; India by far #1 importer.

companies.name: AGT Food and Ingredients
companies.note: Regina-based, one of the world's largest pulse splitters/processors (lentils, peas, chickpeas, beans); part of a Mitsubishi-backed group.
companies.improve: Should publish per-origin processed-pulse volumes and farmer-pricing transparency.

companies.name: Olam Agri / ofi
companies.note: Global agri-trader; large pulses/edible-nuts platform sourcing from Canada, Australia, Africa into India and MENA.
companies.improve: Should break out pulse origination tonnage by origin from group ingredient figures.

companies.name: Export Trading Group (ETG)
companies.note: Africa-rooted global agri-supply-chain firm; major pulse exporter (pigeon pea, chickpea, beans) from Tanzania/Ethiopia to India.
companies.improve: Should disclose smallholder-sourcing share and India-dependence of its pulse book.

companies.name: Viterra
companies.note: Glencore-controlled grain/oilseed/pulse handler; significant Canadian and Australian pulse origination and export.
companies.improve: Post-Bunge merger, should clarify combined pulse-export capacity to avoid double-counting.

companies.name: Ingredion
companies.note: Ingredients maker expanding in pulse-based proteins, flours and starches (pea/chickpea/faba).
companies.improve: Should report pulse-protein input volumes by origin.

companies.name: Roquette
companies.note: World leader in pea protein and pulse-based ingredients (large pea-protein plants in France and Canada).
companies.improve: Should disclose pea-protein feedstock origin and the deforestation-free share.

global.note: Global pulses (FAOSTAT HS 0713 family / FAO pulse aggregate), kt. World production ~98 Mt in 2024 with India ~27 Mt; Canada the export leader; traded volume ~20 Mt.
